sources.title: Ellis Island manifest listing 'Belfiore, Antonio' of S. Bartolomeo as a returning US citizen, SS Duca di Genova
sources.repository: National Archives microfilm T715, roll 1352 (RG 85), List 36, line 12; Ancestry.com collection 7488, record 4005267966, images NYT715_1352-0340 and 0373
sources.note: UNRESOLVED CONFLICT. SS Duca di Genova from Naples (sheet dated 29 Sep 1909), arrived New York 11 Oct 1909. Line 12, "Belfiore Antonio", is struck through and stamped "U.S.C. DISCHARGED ON PIER": he was taken off the alien list as a US citizen. Last residence S. Bartolomeo, Benevento; nearest relative left behind: his wife, at San Bartolomeo in Galdo; final destination (index) Cleveland, Ohio. Age not readable (perhaps 46 or 48). Our Antonio's wife and children were all in New Rochelle by 1900 and he owned a house on Brook Street in 1910, so this is probably a different Antonio Belfiore. Not proven either way.

sources.note: Annie Marie Hussey, birth year given as 1886, New York, on Dean Street. Mother Maria Hussey, head, born Ireland. Siblings Theodore, Mary Ellen, Sizzie (Lizzie), and Frank. The indexed age and the 1886 birth year do not agree; the 1914 marriage age fits a birth about 1886 or 1887.

sources.title: 1910 U.S. census, New Rochelle Ward 2: Annie Hussy, grocery bookkeeper
sources.repository: 1910 U.S. census, New Rochelle Ward 2; Ancestry.com collection 7884, record 20226845
sources.note: Annie Hussy, 23, born New York, parents born Ireland, bookkeeper in a grocery, Cleveland Avenue, in the household of Frank J. Chapman. An aunt, Annie Dunne, 71, is in the house.

sources.title: Standard-Star marriage notices: Miss Dorothy Eleanore Hennessy and Joseph Belfiore, May 1946
sources.repository: The Standard-Star, New Rochelle, via Ancestry Newspapers.com Marriage Index, collection 62116
sources.note: 18 May 1946 notice (record 982161926): Miss Dorothy Eleanore Hennessy to Joseph Belfiore, father Patrick J. Hennessy. A 10 May 1946 notice (record 668024932) gives her residence as Premium Point. A 15 May 1945 engagement notice names P. J. Hennessy. The index is machine-read and can garble a name.

sources.title: A second 1946 marriage-index line naming Joseph P. Hennessy as Dorothy's father
sources.repository: Ancestry Newspapers.com Marriage Index, collection 62116, record 948716524
sources.note: The same day's index gives a residence on Clove Road and a father Joseph P. Hennessy, with siblings whose names look like a misreading of Francis and Joseph. Not used as her father. Shown because the records disagree.

sources.title: New York State marriage index: Dorothy E. Hennessy, 12 May 1946, New Rochelle, certificate 23239
sources.repository: New York State marriage index, via Ancestry.com collection 61632, record 6229028
sources.note: Dorothy E. Hennessy married 12 May 1946 in New Rochelle, certificate 23239. The newspaper notice says 19 May. No image was saved.

sources.title: World War I draft card: Patrick Joseph Hennessy, born 18 April 1877
sources.repository: Ancestry.com collection 6482, record 8491713
sources.note: A Patrick Joseph Hennessy, born 18 April 1877, of 87 Huguenot Street, New Rochelle, spouse written Inna. The birthday does not match the 1874 baptism. Kept as an unresolved other reading, not as his birth date. No image was saved.

sources.title: 1930 U.S. census, New Rochelle: Thomas S. Hennessy, lawyer, no children
sources.repository: 1930 U.S. census, New Rochelle; Ancestry.com collection 6224, record 46967753
sources.note: Thomas S. Hennessy, born about 1900 in New York, a lawyer, wife Margaret S., 27, no children in the household, parents born in Ireland. He had married at about 30. He is not Dorothy's father. No image was saved.

sources.title: The Immigration page of this site
sources.repository: This site
sources.note: Published page. Cited for Blessed Sacrament Church at 15 Shea Place (Centre Avenue), Holy Sepulchre Cemetery at 95 Kings Highway, and the statement that 46 Mechanic Street was renamed Memorial Highway and the house came down about 1960. The page's claim that the family lived at that house for 58 years is not used. The death certificate gives 58 years in New Rochelle, and the censuses put the household on other streets.
